numerical.scope: Direct block reductions with unchanged full contracts/domain and FP order; two-reference numerical validation/release, reduction lanes/count corpus and integrated cache/CRB gates. Separate from whole-unit formal proof, integrated movement timing and full MuJoCo completion.

corpus.scope: Direct Dot_Blocks bit-exact lane results and rejection counts, Dot_Four bit-exact merge/tails, fast boundary and old ordered acceptance/fallback over dense and strided sparse ancestor patterns up to 256 DOFs. Signed zero/all-large products included. Separate from formal proof, ideal-real accuracy and full C equivalence/performance.

baseline_rebuild.difference_diagnosis: Only relative RPATH string changes with original build-directory depth, and its derived dynamic-string offsets/version address. readelf dynamic symbols text is identical; machine instructions, rodata, data and other allocated payload bytes match. Full ELF identity is not claimed. Replicated benchmark verifies actual copied executable and shared-library hashes separately.

direct-dot-replicas-r557.scope: Supported integrated smooth Euler movement. Identical-SHA replicas at equal-length paths, normalized argv0, shared immutable fixtures, balanced cyclic/reverse orders and replica-then-block bootstrap. Placement variability included; no identified allocator/cache cause, universal C equivalence, full port or overall C-parity claim.

direct-dot-replicas-r562.scope: Supported integrated smooth Euler movement. Identical-SHA replicas at equal-length paths, normalized argv0, shared immutable fixtures, balanced cyclic/reverse orders and replica-then-block bootstrap. Placement variability included; no identified allocator/cache cause, universal C equivalence, full port or overall C-parity claim.

scope: Closed 197-check direct-block minimum and 53-check ghost small-row minimum, with inherited diagnostics separate. Full direct unit hit 900-second watchdog, without completed report. Two-reference 13 numerical gates and bit-exact lane/count corpus pass. Thirty three-copy and fifteen six-copy integrated cases do not show multi-DOF benefit; runtime candidate remains private. Hinge gains and free-ball/chain uncertainty/regressions retained per workload. New fused compiler-boundary candidate inputs only are frozen; its active proof/build outputs are excluded. Full port, dynamics Gold and C parity remain unfinished.
